verdict.rationale: Parahelp documents an API for running the Customer Agent and the Internal Agent, so this axis applies. However, no evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec: the probe found every common OpenAPI and Swagger path returning 404. The llms.txt file is a documentation index, not a machine-readable API spec, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
